map.由长、宽、高求体积 使用指南: Volume from Length, Width and Height User Guide
map.输入长方体的长、宽、高，计算其体积 V=l·w·h 与表面积，用于装箱、房间容积: Enter the length, width and height of a cuboid to compute its volume V=l·w·h and surface area, for size estimation and material quantity checks on rectangular objects such as packing, room volume and storage space.
map.输入长、宽、高，求长方体体积与表面积。: Enter the length, width and height to get the volume and surface area of the cuboid.
map.容积估算：装箱、房间、仓储空间的体积: Volume estimate: for packing, rooms and storage space
map.材料用量：六面表面积核算包装/涂装量: Material quantity: use the six-surface area to check packaging and coating amounts
map.量级判断：三维缩放下的体积-表面积关系: Magnitude judgement: the volume and surface area relation under three-dimensional scaling
map.：算法：体积 V=l·w·h；表面积 A=2(lw+wh+hl)（六面之和）。要: Algorithm: volume V=l·w·h; surface area A=2(lw+wh+hl) (the sum of the six faces). Requires l,w,h>0; the units must be consistent, with volume in cubic units and area in square units.
map.扇形面积（A = r²·θ / 2，θ 为弧度）: Sector Area (A = r²·θ / 2, θ in radians)

map.由半径求球的体积: Volume of a sphere from the radius
map.表面积包含几个面？: How many faces does the surface area include?
map.长方体 6 个面成对相等：2 个 lw、2 个 wh、2 个 hl，合计 2(l: The six faces of a cuboid come in equal pairs: 2 of lw, 2 of wh and 2 of hl, totalling 2(lw+wh+hl); if only the side area is wanted (excluding top and bottom) subtract 2lw.
map.体积和边长成什么比例？: What is the relation between volume and edge length?
map.体积与任一边长线性相关（其余固定）；三维同时放大 k 倍则体积放大 k³ 倍——: The volume is linearly related to any one edge (with the others fixed); scaling all three dimensions by k scales the volume by k³, the square-cube law, and the surface area by k².
